description: This file defines a PHP class WorkExperience within the OrangeHRM project. The class acts as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for representing an employee's work experience, providing methods to convert to an array and to map database fields to getter methods.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: A DTO class representing the work experience of an employee, capable of normalizing data for reporting purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WorkExperience DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the employee's work experience data to an array, filtered by specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns a mapping of field names to their corresponding getter method chains for retrieving data.
